title: Warehouse Wanderer
name: Warehouse Wanderer
summary: An Android/iOS warehouse-visit passport with local visit tracking, wishlists and targeted UI tests.

cardSummary: An Android/iOS warehouse-visit passport with local visit tracking, wishlists and targeted UI tests.

caseStudy.problem: An Android/iOS warehouse-visit passport with local visit tracking, wishlists and targeted UI tests.
caseStudy.role: Personal project: implementation, integration and testing.
architecture: Expo/React Native screens use local persistence and warehouse data providers. Config plugins preserve native setup when Expo regenerates Android and iOS hosts.
validation: Public source includes documented focused test commands; see the repository validation notes for current results.
limitations: Independent, unofficial prototype with no retailer affiliation. Prior Android emulator flows passed; no physical Android acceptance is established. Native builds require a compatible JDK/Android SDK. Optional map features need your own API key.
